title: Way Music Lab
summary: An engine-independent procedural music generator with orchestral playback, variable meters, narrative scoring, and MIDI, JSON, and WAV export.
description:
Way Music Lab generates seeded game scores and plays them in the browser using recorded orchestral instruments. It includes fantasy scene presets, intensity controls, variable time-signature cycles, and syncopated math-rock rhythms. Scores can be exported as MIDI or JSON, with offline WAV rendering.

A narrative score director connects an authored theme to title screens, exploration, player movement, danger, and timed story cues. The composition core and score contract are portable; browser playback is implemented, while a native Unreal adapter remains future work.

The original software is MIT-licensed. Its compact recorded orchestra uses CC0 VSCO CE recordings with bundled attribution.
